name: agent-teams
description: A thin governance layer for selective Codex native-subagent delegation, disjoint writers, and frozen-snapshot review

interface.shortDescription: Delegate only independent work with measurable coordination value
interface.longDescription: Keep simple and tightly coupled work in the root agent. Use Codex native subagents only for independently verifiable branches, disjoint writers behind a frozen contract, or read-only reviewers on one frozen snapshot.
defaultPrompt: Decide whether this task has an independently verifiable branch that materially reduces elapsed time or parent context pressure; keep it local otherwise.
Coordinate parallel implementation only after shared contracts and disjoint write scopes are frozen.
Review one frozen snapshot with independent read-only dimensions, then consolidate before repair.
